L27: ERRATA 2
L28: 
L29:   * E1 Android Self Repair card overrides rulebook on Serious Wounds designer
L30: 
L31: RULING
L32:     The Android's Self Repair ability does not heal Serious Wounds. The card description overrides the rulebook text on this point.
L33: 
L34: AUTHOR: Lord_StarfoX (Peter B., citing Adam Kwapiński)SOURCE: 【4†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(47 replies, 50 thumbs)DATE: 2021-03-06
L35:   * E2 Ammo cannot be removed from weapons; transfers with the weapon on trade community high-engagement
L36: 
L37: RULING
L38:     Characters cannot remove ammo from their weapons. When a weapon is traded to another character, the ammo stays with the weapon.
L39: 
L40: AUTHOR: Natai (Sean McLaughlin, comparing printed Wave 1 rulebook to current Awaken Realms PDF)SOURCE: 【5†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(17 replies, 73 thumbs)DATE: 2021-05-31
L41: 
L42: DESIGNER CLARIFICATIONS 45
L43:   * D1 Scout's auto-search trait is mandatory publisher
L44: 
L45: RULING
L46:     The Scout's trait that automatically searches grey rooms is obligatory. The Scout cannot choose to search normally instead.
L47: 
L48: AUTHOR: Awaken Realms (publisher)SOURCE: 【6†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】DATE: 2020-03-09
L49: 
L50:   * D2 Eggs in the Nest can be targeted during combat publisher
L51: 
L52: CONTEXT
L53:     Players were uncertain whether combat with an Intruder blocked targeting Eggs in the same room.
L54: RULING
L55:     You can attack Eggs in the Nest during combat with an Intruder. A noise roll must be made normally even though you are already in combat.
L56: 
L57: AUTHOR: Awaken Realms (publisher)SOURCE: 【6†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】DATE: 2020-03-09
L58: 
L59:   * D3 Android cannot heal Serious Wounds via ship actions publisher
L60: 
L61: RULING
L62:     The Android character cannot heal dressed Serious Wounds through any ship action (e.g., Hibernation Chamber, Medical Bay).
L63: AUTHOR: Awaken Realms (publisher)SOURCE: 【6†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】DATE: 2020-03-09
L64: 
L65:   * D4 Turret firing conditions and targeting rules publisher
L66: 
L67: CONTEXT
L68:     Players were unclear on when turrets fire and what they hit.
L69: 
L70: RULING
L71:     Turrets fire in two cases: (1) when something enters the room, and (2) during the Fire Damage phase. A Target:All turret deals 1 Light Wound to characters AND 1 Injury to intruders in the room. A Target:Intruders turret hits only intruders.
L72: AUTHOR: Awaken Realms (publisher)SOURCE: 【6†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】DATE: 2020-03-09
L73: 
L74:   * D5 Bandages can be used on other players publisher
L75: 
L76: RULING
L77:     The Bandages item can be used on other players, not only on yourself.
L78: 
L79: AUTHOR: Awaken Realms (publisher)SOURCE: 【6†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】DATE: 2020-03-09
L80: 
L81:   * D6 Flamethrower and Medic weapon cannot be reloaded during combat publisher
L82: RULING
L83:     The Flamethrower (and the Medic's weapon) cannot be reloaded during combat. Reloading them is treated as using a Chemicals item, which is not permitted in combat.
L84: 
L85: AUTHOR: Awaken Realms (publisher)SOURCE: 【6†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】DATE: 2020-03-09
L86: 
L87:   * D7 Claw Attack does not kill a character already at wound threshold designer
L88: CONTEXT
L89:     Players debated whether a Claw Attack's combined damage could simultaneously trigger death when the character is already near their wound limit.
L90: 
L91: RULING
L92:     If a character has 2 Serious Wounds (3 for the Convict) and 2 Light Wounds, and receives a Claw Attack (2 Light Wounds + Contamination), they survive. The killing blow must come from a separate source of damage.
L93: AUTHOR: Lord_StarfoX (Peter B., citing Adam Kwapiński)SOURCE: 【4†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(47 replies, 50 thumbs)DATE: 2021-03-06
L94: 
L95:   * D8 Fire Damage resolves from lowest room number, largest intruder first designer
L96: 
L97: RULING
L98:     In the Fire Damage step, resolve damage to intruders from the lowest-numbered room to the highest. Within the same room, resolve from largest to smallest intruder type.
L99: AUTHOR: Lord_StarfoX (Peter B., citing Awaken Realms)SOURCE: 【4†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(47 replies, 50 thumbs)DATE: 2021-03-06
L100: 
L101:   * D9 Intruder attacks in the Event Phase resolve in Player order designer
L102: 
L103: RULING
L104:     Each intruder attack in the Event Phase is resolved in Player order, not in Room order.
L105: 
L106: AUTHOR: Lord_StarfoX (Peter B., citing Awaken Realms)SOURCE: 【4†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(47 replies, 50 thumbs)DATE: 2021-03-06
L107:   * D10 Intruder fleeing into another fire room takes a second fire injury designer
L108: 
L109: RULING
L110:     During the Fire Damage step, if an intruder takes a fire injury and flees to a higher-numbered room that is also on fire (whose fire has not yet been resolved), that intruder takes another fire injury.
L111: 
L112: AUTHOR: Lord_StarfoX (Peter B., citing Awaken Realms)SOURCE: 【4†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(47 replies, 50 thumbs)DATE: 2021-03-06
L113:   * D11 Destroyed Nest still spawns eggs in Intruder Bag Development designer
L114: 
L115: RULING
L116:     A destroyed Nest can still spawn eggs during the Intruder Bag Development step. The Nest remains destroyed regardless.
L117: 
L118: AUTHOR: Lord_StarfoX (Peter B., citing Awaken Realms)SOURCE: 【4†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(47 replies, 50 thumbs)DATE: 2021-03-06
L119: 
L120:   * D12 Technical Corridors Event causes no noise roll if intruder is already present designer
L121: RULING
L122:     The Technical Corridors Event does not trigger noise rolls in a room that already has an intruder.
L123: 
L124: AUTHOR: Lord_StarfoX (Peter B., citing Adam Kwapiński)SOURCE: 【4†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(47 replies, 50 thumbs)DATE: 2021-03-06
L125: 
L126:   * D13 Intruder retreating through a closed door destroys the door designer
L127: RULING
L128:     If an intruder retreats through a closed door (including when forced by the fire extinguisher), the door is destroyed and the intruder stays in the room — identical to normal intruder movement rules.
L129: 
L130: AUTHOR: wpflug13 (Will, citing Adam Kwapiński)SOURCE: 【7†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(27 replies, 31 thumbs)DATE: 2018-11-28
L131: 
L132:   * D14 Blank token returns to the Intruder bag every time it is drawn designer
L133: RULING
L134:     The blank token is returned to the Intruder bag whenever it is drawn for an encounter — not only when it is the last token remaining in the bag.
L135: 
L136: AUTHOR: wpflug13 (Will, citing Adam Kwapiński)SOURCE: 【7†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(27 replies, 31 thumbs)DATE: 2018-11-28
L137: 
L138:   * D15 No "empty" actions are permitted designer
L139: RULING
L140:     Actions that accomplish nothing are not permitted: you cannot Trade if nothing ends up being traded, reload a fully-loaded weapon, or Rest without a Contamination card in hand.
L141: 
L142: AUTHOR: Lord_StarfoX (Peter B., citing Adam Kwapiński)SOURCE: 【4†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(47 replies, 50 thumbs)DATE: 2021-03-06
L143: 
L144:   * D16 Interruption can cancel triggered character reactions designer
L145: RULING
L146:     The Interruption action can be used to cancel triggered reactions such as "Nerves of Steel", "Don't Panic", and the Scout's "Motion Scanner".
L147: 
L148: AUTHOR: Lord_StarfoX (Peter B., citing Awaken Realms)SOURCE: 【4†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(47 replies, 50 thumbs)DATE: 2021-03-06
L149: 
L150:   * D17 Interruption can be played after a player has already passed designer
L151: 
L152: RULING
L153:     A player may play an Interruption action card even after they have already passed their turn that round.
L154: AUTHOR: wpflug13 (Will, citing Adam Kwapiński)SOURCE: 【7†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(27 replies, 31 thumbs)DATE: 2018-11-28
L155: 
L156:   * D18 You cannot attack a larva that is on your character board designer
L157: 
L158: RULING
L159:     Once a larva is on your character board (after you have been infested), you cannot attack it.
L160: 
L161: AUTHOR: wpflug13 (Will, citing Adam Kwapiński)SOURCE: 【7†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(27 replies, 31 thumbs)DATE: 2018-11-28
L162:   * D19 Escape Pods containing a character cannot be locked designer
L163: 
L164: RULING
L165:     A room containing a character inside an Escape Pod cannot be locked.
L166: 
L167: AUTHOR: Lord_StarfoX (Peter B., citing Awaken Realms)SOURCE: 【4†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(47 replies, 50 thumbs)DATE: 2021-03-06
L168: 
L169:   * D20 Characters in an Escape Pod are not considered to be in the room designer
L170: 
L171: CONTEXT
L172:     Players were uncertain whether Escape Pod occupants counted as being in the room for purposes of Interruption and noise.
L173: RULING
L174:     Characters inside an Escape Pod that has not yet departed are not considered to be in the room — the Interruption action cannot be used by them. However, noise rolls must still be made during the Intruder Bag Development step as if they were in the room.
L175: 
L176: AUTHOR: Lord_StarfoX (Peter B., citing Awaken Realms)SOURCE: 【4†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(47 replies, 50 thumbs)DATE: 2021-03-06
L177: 
L178:   * D21 CEO can use "Just One More Thing" in Escape Pod after passing, with one exception designer
L179: RULING
L180:     The CEO may use "Just One More Thing" while inside an Escape Pod after having passed, in order to leave the pod — unless the CEO is the final player to pass that round.
L181: 
L182: AUTHOR: Lord_StarfoX (Peter B., citing Awaken Realms)SOURCE: 【4†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(47 replies, 50 thumbs)DATE: 2021-03-06
L183: 
L184:   * D22 Second Airlock Procedure in the same room cancels the first designer
L185: RULING
L186:     If an Airlock Token is already placed in a room, activating a second Airlock Procedure cancels the original one.
L187: 
L188: AUTHOR: Lord_StarfoX (Peter B., citing Awaken Realms)SOURCE: 【4†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(47 replies, 50 thumbs)DATE: 2021-03-06
L189: 
L190:   * D23 Airlock vents Heavy Objects; Laika is immune designer
L191: 
L192: RULING
L193:     The Airlock Procedure retains all Heavy Objects in the room (they are not vented into space). Laika is also immune to the Airlock Procedure and remains in the room.
L194: AUTHOR: Lord_StarfoX (Peter B., citing Awaken Realms)SOURCE: 【4†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(47 replies, 50 thumbs)DATE: 2021-03-06
L195: 
L196:   * D24 Hibernation does not stop the Self-Destruct sequence once activated designer
L197: 
L198: RULING
L199:     If the Self-Destruct sequence is already activated, entering the Hibernation Chamber will not stop it.
L200: 
L201: AUTHOR: wpflug13 (Will, citing Adam Kwapiński)SOURCE: 【7†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(27 replies, 31 thumbs)DATE: 2018-11-28
L202:   * D25 Coolant Leak Event triggers Self-Destruct timer regardless of hibernation status designer
L203: 
L204: RULING
L205:     The Coolant Leak Event triggers the self-destruct timer even if a character is currently in the Hibernation Chamber.
L206: 
L207: AUTHOR: wpflug13 (Will, citing Adam Kwapiński)SOURCE: 【7†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(27 replies, 31 thumbs)DATE: 2018-11-28
L208: 
L209:   * D26 Slime room with Silence exploration token resolves as Danger designer
L210: CONTEXT
L211:     Players were unsure how to resolve the exploration token in the Slime room when it shows Silence.
L212: 
L213: RULING
L214:     If a character enters the Room Covered in Slime and reveals a Silence exploration token, the slime effect is applied immediately upon entering (gaining a slime token), and then the exploration token is resolved as Danger.
L215: 
L216: AUTHOR: wpflug13 (Will, citing Adam Kwapiński)SOURCE: 【7†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(27 replies, 31 thumbs)DATE: 2018-11-28
L217:   * D27 Hatching Event is an Encounter only if a player is in the Nest designer
L218: 
L219: CONTEXT
L220:     Two separate compilations address different aspects of the Hatching Event and encounters.
L221: 
L222: RULING
L223:     The Hatching Event only triggers an encounter if there is a player in the Nest when the event resolves. When a character is infested or attacked as a result of the Hatching Event, it counts as an Encounter and Objectives must be chosen.
L224: AUTHOR: Lord_StarfoX (citing Awaken Realms); wpflug13 (citing Adam Kwapiński)SOURCE: 【4†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】DATE: 2021-03-06
L225: 
L226:   * D28 Fire spreads into unexplored rooms designer
L227: 
L228: RULING
L229:     Fire markers can spread into unexplored rooms normally.
L230: 
L231: AUTHOR: wpflug13 (Will, citing Adam Kwapiński)SOURCE: 【7†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(27 replies, 31 thumbs)DATE: 2018-11-28
L232: 
L233:   * D29 Being infested a second time does not kill you designer
L234: CONTEXT
L235:     Players were confused about what happens when a character with a larva on their board is infested again.
L236: 
L237: RULING
L238:     If you already have a larva on your character board and are infested by a second larva, you do not die. Instead, take a Contamination card and remove the larva miniature from the game board.
L239: 
L240: AUTHOR: wpflug13 (Will, citing Adam Kwapiński)SOURCE: 【7†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(27 replies, 31 thumbs)DATE: 2018-11-28
L241:   * D30 Scanning multiple Infected contamination cards in one action places only one Larva designer
L242: 
L243: RULING
L244:     When a scanning action scans multiple contamination cards and more than one reads Infected, you place only one Larva miniature on your character board. You do not die, regardless of how many Infected results appear in a single scanning action.
L245: 
L246: AUTHOR: Lord_StarfoX (citing Awaken Realms); wpflug13 (citing Adam Kwapiński)SOURCE: 【4†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】DATE: 2021-03-06
L247:   * D31 Android immediately scans received Contamination cards and draws an Action card designer
L248: 
L249: RULING
L250:     When the Android receives a Contamination card, she immediately scans it and then draws an Action card. The Android will therefore never have a Contamination card in her Action deck.
L251: 
L252: AUTHOR: Lord_StarfoX (Peter B., citing Awaken Realms)SOURCE: 【4†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(47 replies, 50 thumbs)DATE: 2021-03-06
L253:   * D32 Antidote scans all contamination from hand, deck, and discard pile designer
L254: 
L255: CONTEXT
L256:     Players were unsure whether Antidote only scanned cards in hand or the full action deck.
L257: 
L258: RULING
L259:     When using the Antidote item, scan all contamination cards from your hand, deck, and discard pile simultaneously. After adding the new contamination card from the Antidote effect, shuffle all action cards together to form a new deck — no cards remain in hand or discard pile.
L260: AUTHOR: wpflug13 (Will, citing Adam Kwapiński)SOURCE: 【7†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(27 replies, 31 thumbs)DATE: 2018-11-28
L261: 
L262:   * D33 Decoy targets the character with fewest Action cards; Player order breaks ties designer
L263: 
L264: RULING
L265:     Intruders affected by the Decoy always target the character who has the fewest Action cards in hand (including Contamination cards). Player order is the tiebreaker.
L266: AUTHOR: Lord_StarfoX (Peter B., citing Adam Kwapiński)SOURCE: 【4†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(47 replies, 50 thumbs)DATE: 2021-03-06
L267: 
L268:   * D34 CEO's Robot — Serious Wounds treated as Dressed while Robot has Energy designer
L269: 
L270: RULING
L271:     Whenever the CEO's Robot has at least one Energy marker, all of the CEO's Body Serious Wounds are treated as "Dressed" (or "Re-Dressed").
L272: AUTHOR: Lord_StarfoX (Peter B., citing Awaken Realms)SOURCE: 【4†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(47 replies, 50 thumbs)DATE: 2021-03-06
L273: 
L274:   * D35 Soldier's Assault Rifle Full Auto action can target Eggs in the Nest designer
L275: 
L276: RULING
L277:     The Soldier's Assault Rifle may use the Full Auto action to shoot Eggs in the Nest. It is possible to destroy all Eggs in the Nest with a single action.
L278: AUTHOR: Lord_StarfoX (Peter B., citing Awaken Realms)SOURCE: 【4†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(47 replies, 50 thumbs)DATE: 2021-03-06
L279: 
L280:   * D36 Analyze Object Weakness requires the object to be carried by you designer
L281: 
L282: RULING
L283:     You can analyze an object for its Weakness while you are carrying it, but you cannot analyze an object being carried by another character.
L284: AUTHOR: Lord_StarfoX (Peter B., citing Awaken Realms)SOURCE: 【4†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(47 replies, 50 thumbs)DATE: 2021-03-06
L285: 
L286:   * D37 Android's Deactivation Module works against all Intruder Attacks designer
L287: 
L288: RULING
L289:     The Android's Deactivation Module can be used against any and all Intruder Attacks against her, without restriction.
L290: 
L291: AUTHOR: Lord_StarfoX (Peter B., citing Awaken Realms)SOURCE: 【4†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(47 replies, 50 thumbs)DATE: 2021-03-06
L292:   * D38 Mechanic's Ingenuity and Handyman: only useful for crafting a Screwdriver designer
L293: 
L294: CONTEXT
L295:     Players were confused by the interaction between the Mechanic's Ingenuity Action card and the Handyman trait.
L296: RULING
L297:     Ingenuity allows the Mechanic to treat a Yellow Item (from the Yellow Item Deck) as a Screwdriver for crafting. Handyman allows the Mechanic's Activated Quest Items to count as Yellow Items for crafting. Without Ingenuity, Handyman has no use. Together, the only purpose of Handyman is to enable crafting a Screwdriver from an Activated Quest Item.
L298: 
L299: AUTHOR: Lord_StarfoX (Peter B., citing Awaken Realms)SOURCE: 【4†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(47 replies, 50 thumbs)DATE: 2021-03-06
L300:   * D39 Soldier's Autoloader cost reduction is cancelled by a Hand Serious Wound designer
L301: 
L302: RULING
L303:     The Soldier's Autoloader reduces the Action cost of loading an Energy Charge from 1 to 0. A Hand Serious Wound reverts that cost back to 1.
L304: 
L305: AUTHOR: Lord_StarfoX (Peter B., citing Awaken Realms)SOURCE: 【4†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(47 replies, 50 thumbs)DATE: 2021-03-06
L306: 
L307:   * D40 Captain's Log Key can reveal both Objective cards before first Intruder encounter designer
L308: RULING
L309:     The Captain may use his Log Key to look at both Objective cards of a player, provided the first Intruder has not yet been encountered.
L310: 
L311: AUTHOR: Lord_StarfoX (Peter B., citing Awaken Realms)SOURCE: 【4†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(47 replies, 50 thumbs)DATE: 2021-03-06
L312: 
L313:   * D41 Crafted Items return to the Craft Items Deck when discarded designer
L314: RULING
L315:     Discarded crafted items go back into the Craft Items Deck. There should always be exactly 3 crafted items of the same type between all players' possession and the Craft Items Deck combined.
L316: 
L317: AUTHOR: Lord_StarfoX (Peter B., citing Awaken Realms)SOURCE: 【4†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(47 replies, 50 thumbs)DATE: 2021-03-06
L318: 
L319:   * D42 If the Cuffs Key holder dies permanently, the Convict remains cuffed designer
L320: RULING
L321:     If a character permanently dies while holding the Cuffs Key, the Convict remains cuffed for the remainder of the game.
L322: 
L323: AUTHOR: Lord_StarfoX (Peter B., citing Awaken Realms)SOURCE: 【4†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(47 replies, 50 thumbs)DATE: 2021-03-06
L324: 
L325:   * D43 Captain's Intercom + Motivation draws cards for characters near any computer designer
L326: 
L327: CONTEXT

L292:   * D38 Mechanic's Ingenuity and Handyman: only useful for crafting a Screwdriver designer
L293: 
L294: CONTEXT
L295:     Players were confused by the interaction between the Mechanic's Ingenuity Action card and the Handyman trait.
L296: RULING
L297:     Ingenuity allows the Mechanic to treat a Yellow Item (from the Yellow Item Deck) as a Screwdriver for crafting. Handyman allows the Mechanic's Activated Quest Items to count as Yellow Items for crafting. Without Ingenuity, Handyman has no use. Together, the only purpose of Handyman is to enable crafting a Screwdriver from an Activated Quest Item.
